notes: InfernToken (src/InfernToken.sol) is a plain fixed-supply OpenZeppelin ERC-20 named Infernidentity.md with symbol INFERN and 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints 1,000,000,000 * 10^18 tokens once to msg.sender (the factory). It has no owner, no further minting, no fees, burns or transfer restrictions, and no privileged functions. No application contracts are deployed with this launch.
